snippet.title: Rest Area Simulator - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
*Manage a modern highway rest area.* Run a *gas station, market, supermarket,* and *car wash* — alone or *CO-OP,* *_all packed into one game!_*
Enjoy a rich simulation experience with dynamic weather, a full economy system, day–night cycle, and unique NPC behavior.

🛒 *Steam Page:* https://store.steampowered.com/app/3732960/Rest_Area_Simulator/
💌 Don't forget to add it to your *wishlist* and *follow* the game!

📦 Press Kit & More Info: https://restareasimulator.oriseus.com/index.html#presskit

🎮 *Game Features*
👥 *CO-OP:* Play solo or in multiplayer with 1–4 players
⛽ *Gas Station:* Manage fuel sales
🛒 *Market & Supermarket:* Buy products, stock shelves, and earn profit
🚗 *Car Wash:* Serve vehicles and keep customers happy
👨‍🔧 *Employees:* Hire, manage, and improve your staff to boost efficiency
⭐ *Reputation System:* Make your rest area popular
🌦️ *Dynamic Weather:* Sun, rain, storms — everything affects your business
🕒 *Day-Night Cycle:* Time progresses with changing light and rhythm
📈 *Economy System:* Prices change based on supply and demand
 🧍  *Advanced NPCs:* Visitors with unique needs and behaviors
🔧 *Task Management:* Share responsibilities in CO-OP gameplay
🏗️ *Expansion:* Grow your business and unlock new areas

⚙️ We plan to add even *more businesses, products, and mechanics* in future updates!

👉 *Wishlist & Steam Page:* https://store.steampowered.com/app/3732960/Rest_Area_Simulator/
